info.title: Sensors Telemetry Service API
info.description: API for managing sensor telemetry data in the Warm House System. This service handles sensor value updates and telemetry operations using Go and Gin framework.

get.description: Returns the current status of the sensors telemetry service. This endpoint is used for health monitoring and service discovery.

patch.description: Update the current value and status of a specific sensor. This endpoint is typically used by telemetry systems to report real-time sensor readings.

SensorValueUpdate.description: Request payload for updating sensor telemetry data

tags.name: Sensors
tags.description: Sensor telemetry and value update operations
